prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 行高瓶颈转移 · 故障复盘 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "模块" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "问题描述" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 578px
  col 3: header "影响范围" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 530px
  col 4: header "修复方案" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 659px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录各模块的故障、影响范围和修复方案，供读者复盘与核对。","reading":"按行从模块读到问题、影响和修复；也可纵向扫描影响范围或修复方案，比较不同故障。较长单元格决定行高，同一行较短的单元格可以利用已有高度换行。","groups":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案共同构成每条故障的复盘链条，都是需要阅读的正文列。","模块列用于快速定位和区分各条记录，应保持紧凑且易于扫描。"],"keep_intact":["模块名称及列标题","HTTPS 等技术标识和数字、单位的组合"],"may_wrap":["问题描述中的自然语句","影响范围中的自然语句","修复方案中的自然语句"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [60, 210, 215, 234] · table 720×368px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 106, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [60, 205, 225, 229] · table 720×368px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 106, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [60, 195, 205, 259] · table 720×345px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"模块列紧凑，四个表头均保持完整；问题、影响和修复三列宽度相近，横向阅读顺畅。HTTPS 保持完整。","problems":"网关的问题描述和搜索的修复方案各占四行，末行分别只剩少量文字；搜索行因此显得偏高。","cause":"问题描述列为 210px，修复方案列为 234px，两列都略窄，导致长文本的末尾落到第四行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"影响范围列较宽，订单行的长描述较容易阅读；模块列和表头仍然清晰。","problems":"网关问题和搜索修复仍各占四行；订单影响中的“10”和“分钟”分处两行，妨碍连续阅读。","cause":"影响范围列增至 225px 后，换行点恰好落在数字与单位之间；问题描述列缩至 205px、修复方案列缩至 229px，也未能减少对应长单元格的行数。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"修复方案列加宽后，搜索行由四行降至三行，整体更紧凑；三条复盘信息仍能按行辨认，表头和 HTTPS 保持完整。","problems":"网关问题仍占四行，且“约”和“7 分钟”被拆到相邻行；修复方案列相对较宽，多数短内容旁留白较多。","cause":"问题描述列只有 195px，网关长句的换行较局促；修复方案列占 259px，使搜索行缩短，但也占用了可供问题描述使用的宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[60,205,195,259],"change":"保留 r1C 已验证可使搜索修复降至三行的宽度，从影响范围列转 10px 给问题描述，观察网关长句的换行能否改善，同时核对订单影响是否仍为三行。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[60,220,190,249],"change":"进一步加宽问题描述，争取减少网关行数；适度收窄修复方案并压缩影响范围，检验两处长内容是否仍能保持三行。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[60,200,210,249],"change":"在问题、影响和修复之间采用较均衡的分配，给订单影响更多空间，同时测试 249px 的修复列能否保住搜索行的三行排版。"}]}
